diagnosis: The export job has exceeded the expected duration for its size; export jobs under 10 GB typically complete within an hour. A job running longer than six hours in the queue is likely stalled and should be cancelled and then resubmitted.
reply:
It looks like your export job (EXP‑40233) has been running for over six hours, which is beyond the usual completion time for a 6 GB export. Please cancel the current job and submit a new one. This should resolve the stall. If the new job also stalls or takes an unusually long time to start, let us know.

You can cancel and resubmit the job through the export console or the API endpoint – if you need detailed steps, our help center has guidance.

If you have any further questions, feel free to reach out. Thank you for your patience!
